# UNITED Nights: The Story Continues

> A new chapter. A new beginning. A new sound. UNITED Nights is Luke Munns' independent continuation of the UNITED worship story. Luke was a founding member and original drummer of Hillsong UNITED. Now a new generation is being invited to carry the hunger forward.

Before the songs travelled the world, there were young people gathering to worship Jesus. Prayer. Passionate praise. Hearts abandoned to God. That was the heartbeat of UNITED. It's the heartbeat of UNITED Nights.

The Hillsong-branded UNITED chapter is finished, parked and archived. The music and memories remain, but the story is moving forward. In 2027, UNITED Nights begins a fresh chapter of worship gatherings, new songs, creativity, collaboration and encounters with the presence of God.

## Questions people ask about Hillsong UNITED and UNITED Nights

### What happened to Hillsong UNITED? Is Hillsong UNITED finished?
The Hillsong-branded UNITED era has been completed and archived. Its songs and influence live on. Founding member Luke Munns is now carrying the original UNITED worship vision forward independently through UNITED Nights.

### What is UNITED Nights? Is it the new Hillsong UNITED?
UNITED Nights is an independent continuation of the UNITED legacy, led by Luke Munns. We honour the history, but we are not trying to recreate yesterday. This is a new sound, new voices, new worship gatherings and a new generation seeking God together.

### Is UNITED Nights connected to Hillsong?
UNITED Nights is not currently affiliated with Hillsong Church or any related Hillsong entity.

### Who is Luke Munns? Was he an original Hillsong UNITED member?
Luke Munns is a Christian artist, songwriter, worship leader, producer and founding member of Hillsong UNITED. He was the band's original drummer and helped shape its early sound. Today he leads UNITED Nights and the next chapter of the story.

### Who designed the original UNITED logo?
Luke Munns created the original stylised UNITED logotype in 2002. Copyright in that original design is held by Chlokomo Holdings Pty Ltd as trustee for Chlokomo Trust.

### Why start UNITED Nights?
Because every generation needs its own encounter with God. UNITED Nights is about gathering people around Jesus again, writing songs we've never heard before, making room for new voices and following where the Holy Spirit leads. The same hunger. A fresh outpouring.

### Who is part of UNITED Nights? Will Joel Houston, Taya or other UNITED musicians join?
New friendships and collaborations are taking shape. Artists, musicians and guests will be announced through UNITED Nights as the journey unfolds.

### Is UNITED Nights a band, an event or a worship movement?
It is a growing independent worship project bringing together gatherings, music, songwriting, creativity and community. One heart. One voice. One sound.

### Is UNITED Nights making new music? When will it begin?
Yes. New songs, collaborations and worship gatherings are in development, with the new chapter beginning in 2027. Follow the journey for confirmed releases, events and announcements.

### Where can I learn about Hillsong UNITED's history and join UNITED Nights?
Explore the developing UNITED history, discover the vision behind UNITED Nights, and join the journey through the official pages below.
